subject: Function-address-identifier
notes: 'This identifier format shall not be specified as a receiving operand.' (cite.py --check 8.4.3.12.3 -> OK 3)). Since kb/Work PB1551 (w1097d) the function-address-identifier has TWO grammar homes: the sending tail of setFunctionAddressStatement (`TO ADDRESS OF? FUNCTION ...`), and nonReceivableIdentifier, the superset every receiving slot parses (receivingIdentifier / setReceivingIdentifier, and CALL / INVOKE BY REFERENCE, which 14.9.4.3 SR5 makes receiving because 8.4.3.1.2 Format 9 lists no function arm). In a receiving position the receiving chokepoint refuses it by this rule from the ReceivingOperandForms table (COBOL3979): conformance:cases/8.4.3.12-Function-address-identifier/pb1551-function-address-receiving pins `CALL ... USING BY REFERENCE ADDRESS OF FUNCTION F`, which was a parse error (COBOL0001). The sending uses stay witnessed by pb452_set_function_pointer and pb452_function_address_runtime.
